name: Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 28
pathways: regulation of Rho protein signal transduction

function.text: ARHGEF28 encodes rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 28. Annotated molecular activities include guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. It participates in small GTPase-mediated signal transduction and regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.
